dct_description_sm: see also Tsleil-Waututh Nation Burrard Inlet 3 Reserve c1870, 2024 https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/KO0PTA

Georeferenced map of Squamish Nation Mission 1 Reserve clipped from original Indian Reserves Burrard Inlet (https://doi.org/10.58066/yrw1-vh08). Land cover and features described on the map includes "Indian" villages, potato patches, old logging camp, a church, "Indian" houses, and lists of the types of soil, timber, and land cover in each of the Reserves.
